annotations.title: EU trade defence measures by CN code

description: EU anti-dumping, countervailing and safeguard regulations as published in the Official Journal (from the Publications Office), each with the CN and TARIC codes found in its text, the countries of origin, the product, the action (provisional or definitive duty, amendment, extension, repeal, termination, registration, initiation) and the EUR-Lex link. Search by CN code (a regulation naming 7208 matches 72085120 and the reverse), date, instrument, action or country. Pass next_cursor back as cursor to page or to poll. Duty rates in force are in TARIC; the Official Journal is authoritative. Free.

cn.description: CN code, 4 to 10 digits, e.g. 7208 or 72085120

instrument.description: One instrument only (steel: acts under the EU steel regime, Regulation 2026/1384)

since.description: Regulations dated on or after, YYYY-MM-DD
